[RBND.4b.1] The "resolved RT configuration" is the realtime
contract the engine is operating under: cap values supplied by
the author in a `.dsrt` file ([RTCT]) and embedded in the
`.dsc` as a `RealtimeContract` atom. The canonical byte serialization
defined here is the input to SHA-256, producing the
`rt_config_sha256` field of [RBND.1.4] and the
`RealtimeContract.rt_config_sha256` proto field of [RTCT.6.2].
